understanding: Verify IER bits 0-3 enable Received-Data THRE Receiver-Line-Status Modem-Status with 0 disabled 1 enabled via readback, and IIR bit0 0 pending 1 none correlated with passive int_o when enabled.
preconditions: Common reset driven then deasserted and observed on fixed-period clock; reset polarity and duration symbolic per q_reset [f_reset_disabled]
LCR DLAB==0 so addresses 0-1 access IER normal registers; IIR accessible [f_dlab_gate]
wishbone_slave_interface bound to wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i with symbolic IER_ADDR==1 and address representation per q_addr
interrupt_output bound to int_o passive observe only, timestamped on fixed clock; asserted versus negated levels symbolic per q_int_o
stimulus_steps: INIT: APPLY common reset; READ IER at symbolic IER_ADDR via wishbone_slave_interface; READ IIR via wishbone_slave_interface; SAMPLE int_o via interrupt_output [f_ier_reset,f_iir_reset,f_reset_disabled]
ENSURE LCR DLAB==0 before any IER IIR access; if DLAB==1 THEN set DLAB==0 first [f_dlab_gate]

FOR each enable in 0x0 to 0xF with reserved 7-4==0: WRITE IER = enable via wishbone_slave_interface; READ IER back; READ IIR; SAMPLE int_o passively [f_ier_b0,f_ier_b1,f_ier_b2,f_ier_b3,f_ier_reserved]
IF dependency traffic creates documented source THEN WAIT for IIR bit0==0 pending else VERIFY IIR bit0==1 none; never drive int_o; per-agent drive only own interface [f_iir_pending]
CLEANUP: LEAVE DLAB==0 idle; WAIT drain_cycles flush; STOP on request_timeout_cycles operational limit
check_steps: COMPARE IER readback [f_ier_b0,f_ier_b1,f_ier_b2,f_ier_b3,f_ier_reserved]: IF (read & 0x0F) != written_enables THEN FAIL; IF (read & 0xF0) != 0 THEN FAIL
COMPARE reset values: IER == 00h [f_ier_reset,f_reset_disabled]; IIR == C1h [f_iir_reset] so bit0==1 none-pending
COMPARE IIR fixed mask on every IIR read: bits7_6==11 AND bits5_4==00 [f_iir_zero,f_iir_one]

COMPARE pending correlation in top scoreboard: SAMPLE IIR bit0 plus int_o level together; IF IIR.bit0==1 THEN EXPECT no-pending with int_o at symbolic NEGATED level; IF IIR.bit0==0 AND corresponding IER bit==1 THEN EXPECT pending with int_o at symbolic ASSERTED level [f_iir_pending]; FAIL on mismatch where enable==1; polarity levels remain symbolic per q_int_o
COMPARE interrupt_output monitor queue vs wishbone IIR poll queue filtered by origin; exclude configuration writes; never compare event with itself
coverage_steps: SAMPLE IER enable combinations 0000b-1111b seen on wishbone_slave_interface monitor; cover each bit 0/1 and all-combinations sweep
SAMPLE IIR bit0 pending 0 vs none 1 correlated with symbolic int_o level seen on interrupt_output subscriber
SAMPLE reset coverage: IER 00h and IIR C1h after common reset
SAMPLE IIR compatibility mask bits7_6==11 and bits5_4==00
completion: Done when reset entry plus all 16 IER enable combinations 0000b-1111b written/read via wishbone_slave_interface with at least one IER scoreboard comparison and at least one IIR-bit0 vs int_o scoreboard comparison observed
Bound by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES plus drain_cycles flush as TESTBENCH operational limits, not DUT timing; stages execute in order, sequences within stage concurrent

IER bit1 THRE empty 0 disabled 1 enabled
facts.quote: 1 RW Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt

facts.statement: IER bit2 Receiver Line Status 0 disabled 1 enabled
IER bit3 Modem Status 0 disabled 1 enabled
IER bits 7-4 Reserved should be logic 0
IER is 8b RW at address 1 Enable Mask interrupts

facts.statement: IIR bit0 0 means interrupt pending 1 means no interrupt pending
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt

facts.statement: IIR bits 6 and 7 are logic 1 for compatibility
facts.quote: Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: IIR reset C1h implying bit0 1 none pending
After reset all interrupts disabled in IER
facts.quote: All interrupts are disabled in the Interrupt Enable Register.
